subject.title: fix: stop node alerts replaying after Gateway restart

question: Should the new atomic claim resolve the same node-ID and client-instance-ID aliases that the previous metadata update handled before this PR lands?
rationale: The removed dual-ID update indicates a compatibility path, while the new one-ID claim has no supplied alias-identity proof; maintaining or intentionally retiring that behavior requires owner judgment.

options.title: Preserve alias resolution
options.body: Extend the atomic claim or canonicalize identity before it so every previously supported paired-node identifier records the timestamp and gets the correct one-time alert.

options.title: Retire the alias path deliberately
options.body: Land the one-ID behavior only with evidence that instance-ID aliases are no longer a shipped pairing contract and with an explicit migration or operator-safe upgrade story.

recommendation.title: Preserve alias resolution
recommendation.body: Extend the atomic claim or canonicalize identity before it so every previously supported paired-node identifier records the timestamp and gets the correct one-time alert.

likelyOwner.reason: The current implementation and its stated pairing-identity design are in this contributor’s commits.
